description: The ships on the live map within a radius of a port (UN/LOCODE) or a point (lat and lon), nearest first: who each is, where, how fast and which way, and how far off. Positions are from the map's ship list, a few minutes old at most. Read any of them with get_ship.

lat.description: Latitude of the point, with lon.

limit.description: At most this many ships, the nearest.

locode.description: A port's UN/LOCODE, five letters; or give lat and lon instead.

lon.description: Longitude of the point, with lat.

radiusKm.description: How far out to look, in kilometres.

name: get_ships_near

url.description: Her page, or the port's, on shiptrail.io.

distanceKm.description: From the centre: tenths under 10 km, whole kilometres beyond.

kind.description: The map's class for her AIS type.

url.description: Her page, or the port's, on shiptrail.io.

total.description: Every ship within the radius; ships lists the nearest of them.
